An '''axe''' (also '''ax''' or '''battle axe''') was a type of [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] of ancient design.

==Description==
The axe could be used as a tool, a melee weapon, or a thrown weapon. Some axes were modernized by being constructed of more advanced materials; these were commonly found in explorers' shops. An advanced version of the axe was the [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]]. The axe had the advantage of being legal nearly everywhere because no one thought to outlaw such a simple tool. Medium-sized, one-handed axes were crafted so that they could be used effectively as a thrown weapon.<ref name="RECG" />

[[Fringer/Legends|Fringers]] found this blade very useful in the wilds of untamed planets.<ref name="RECG" /> The axe was also a main weapon of the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], the porcine [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] from the lush jungle [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. Gamorreans also designed their own larger special axes called [[Arg'garok/Legends|Arg'garoks]].

==History==
[[File:Lirondo.jpg|thumb|left|140px|[[Lirondo]], wielding his axe.]]
A weapon of this type was used by [[Lirondo]] during the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]]. The blades on each side of his axe were extremely sharp and could deal considerable damage to opponents.

The legendary Sith King [[Adas]], who lived before the invention of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], also used a battle axe as his primary weapon.

When various species were pressed into service by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], they brought their own traditional axes along with them when they were shipped across the galaxy.<ref name="RECG" />

The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] woodcutter, [[Chukha-Trok/Legends|Chukha-Trok]], was well-known for using his axe as both a tool and a weapon for taking down his enemies.

Axes were also seen in use by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] Gamorrean bodyguards.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
